name: DataTableToolbar
whenToUse: Above a selectable DataTable: filter / search when idle, bulk actions when rows are selected — in the same strip.

whenNotToUse.text: A table without selection or filters

anatomy.description: checkbox on the left, never moves between states.
replaces the select-all label once rows are picked.
verbs with icons; overflow to “More” when out of room; `tone="danger"` + `confirm` for deletes.

do.caption: Actions appear with the selection, say how many rows, and Delete asks first.

dont.caption: Always-there disabled buttons: no count, no context, easy to miss when they wake up.

a11y: The selection count is a polite live region.
Bulk actions are one Toolbar: a single tab stop, arrows between actions.
Clear returns focus to the select-all checkbox.
Disabled actions explain why (`disabledReason`) in a tooltip.

props.name: allRowsCount
props.description:
Total rows matching the table's current server-side filters.
Paired with `selectAllScope`/`onSelectAllScopeChange` to turn
"select all" into "every filtered row" without resolving a single
id — most paginated list endpoints already return this count
alongside `items`/`total`. Ignored unless `selectAllScope` is also
passed (even as `null`).

props.name: children
props.description: Right-hand side of the idle state — usually a FilterField.

props.name: embedded
props.description: Flush treatment for a toolbar embedded at the bottom of a card.

props.name: idleLeft
props.description: Extra idle-state left-hand content (e.g. a result count).

props.name: maxVisible
props.description: Hard ceiling on inline actions, even when the bar has room for more. Unset: no ceiling.

props.name: minTrailingWidth
props.description: Floor, in px, the idle bar's trailing slot needs before select-all label gives way to a bare checkbox.

props.name: resolveAllRowIds
props.description:
Resolve IDs for every server-side row matching the table's current
filters. The original "select all" strategy for a server-backed
table: the toolbar awaits this (disabling the checkbox meanwhile)
and writes every returned id into `rowSelection`. Fine for a
selection a bulk endpoint expects as an explicit id array; for one
large enough that enumerating it is itself expensive, use
`selectAllScope` instead — the two are mutually exclusive
strategies, and `selectAllScope` wins if both are passed.

props.name: selectAllScope
props.description:
Selection strategy: "every filtered row except these ids", kept by
the caller rather than resolved from a fetch. Passing this prop at
all (even `null`) opts the table into the strategy; `null` means
it's off, `{ excludeIds }` on with those rows carved out. The
toolbar keeps `table`'s own `rowSelection` filled in for whichever
rows are loaded — so DataTable's generated per-row checkboxes read
correctly under "select all" — and reports a loaded row's manual
check/uncheck back through `onSelectAllScopeChange`. The caller
owns clearing it (e.g. on a filter change); the toolbar never
resets it on its own.

components.name: SELECT_COLUMN_ID
components.description: The id DataTable gives its generated checkbox column.
